UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores the authenticated user's display name, status message, and optional profile photo.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

photoBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG base64 thumbnail of the user's profile photo (up to 80000 chars).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ChatGroup.title: ChatGroup
ChatGroup.description: Represents a single or multi-user group chat room identified by an invite code document ID.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the group creator.

description.description: Short group topic or description (0-120 characters).

memberUids.description: Bounded list (1-50) of authenticated member UIDs participating in the group.

lastMessagePreview.description: Preview of the latest message sent in the group (0-120 characters).

lastSenderName.description: Sender name of the latest message (0-40 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the group was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the group was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

GroupMessage.title: GroupMessage
GroupMessage.description: Represents a chat message inside a group chat room with sender identity, photo, status, and content.

senderId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the message author.

senderName.description: Sender name entered by the user (1-40 characters).

senderStatus.description: Sender status message snapshot at send time (0-100 characters).

senderPhotoBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG base64 thumbnail of the sender's profile photo.

memberUids.description: Denormalized list of group member UIDs for rule-enforced query isolation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was sent via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Authenticated user profile with display name, status message, and profile photo.

/groups/{groupId}.description: Group chat rooms supporting both personal and multi-user conversations.

/groups/{groupId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Real-time messages within a group chat room.
